operating_points: Reuse each model’s sealed development operating point.

rules.majority_else_yolo: Select a cluster of at least two model outputs within12px, preferring more members then a cluster containing YOLO. Average its points. Otherwise retain YOLO.
rules.majority_only: Same selection, abstaining when no two models agree.

scope: Exploratory reuse of already opened new-game test; no fresh independent claim. RGB variants are correlated models. No new threshold search.
